description: This file declares the LocalTracer class and related classes, interfaces, and methods for tracing and messaging within the WPEFramework project. It provides mechanisms for enabling/disabling message categories, dispatching messages, and handling callbacks, as well as managing internal threading and singleton instances.

classes.name: LocalTracer
classes.description: Main class providing tracing, messaging, and callback handling functionalities, including singleton management, threading, and message dispatching.

classes.name: LocalTracer::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback implementations to handle messages received by LocalTracer.

classes.name: LocalTracer::MessageSettings
classes.description: Singleton class managing message unit settings, ensuring proper load and configuration.

classes.name: LocalTracer::WorkerThread
classes.description: Internal thread class responsible for periodically calling Dispatch() in LocalTracer.

classes.name: LocalTracer::ConsolePrinter
classes.description: Implementation of ICallback that outputs messages to the console, with optional abbreviated formatting.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Open
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the singleton instance of LocalTracer, initializing message directories and message unit.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Close
methods.description: Closes and deletes the singleton instance, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: LocalTracer::EnableMessage
methods.description: Enables or disables message categories for a specified module.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Dispatch
methods.description: Fetches and processes messages, invoking callbacks.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Callback
methods.description: Sets the callback object for message notifications.
